summary: Tested the move of the store split into Control Room → Deals and the automatic best-card (full payment) detection. All 44 pytest tests pass: 10 new in test_iteration21_best_card.py, plus the iteration 19 and 20 regression tests. In extract_offers, EMI, 'No Cost EMI' and instalment lines are skipped. A % offer saves its 'up to ₹X' cap. mark_best_card on price 24999 picks the SBI offer (10% up to ₹2,000) with saving 2000 over '₹1,500 off HDFC CC', and the ICICI ₹3000 EMI offer is ignored. At price 9999 the HDFC flat ₹1,500 offer wins. Running it twice still leaves exactly one best offer, and coupons are never marked best. UI: the public deals page at '/' has no store-filter-* elements. The category chips work; Gold shows 2 cards. The All tab shows 2 deal-best-card-* boxes ('Best card (full payment): ₹1,750 cashback with HDFC Card · save ₹1,750'). In /admin → admin-tab-deals, the store tabs show counts All 89, Flipkart 3, Amazon 80, Myntra 0, Ajio 4, Other 2 (Other + Swiggy). Each tab filters the rows correctly, and the offers lines show ★ on the best card offer.

minor.issue: 'Max discount Rs 1250' and 'maximum discount of ₹X' are not captured, because CAP_RE needs ₹/Rs right after 'max'/'up to'. So '10% off Axis Credit Card. Max discount Rs 1250' at price 20000 gives saving 2000 instead of 1250. Suggest allowing optional words, e.g. (?:up\s*to|upto|max(?:imum)?)(?:\s*(?:discount|cashback|off|of))*\s*(?:₹|rs\.?|inr)\s*.
Any line containing 'EMI' is dropped entirely, even when it also states a full-payment offer, e.g. '₹1000 off HDFC Credit Card incl. EMI' → no offer. It may be acceptable, but it loses valid offers.
UPI and wallet offers (kind 'bank') can be marked best and shown as 'Best card (full payment): 5% off via UPI'. That label is misleading if the intent is cards only.

action_items: Optional: widen CAP_RE so 'Max discount Rs X' and similar phrasings are capped
Optional: decide whether wallet/UPI offers should count as 'Best card'
critical_code_review_comments: Admin DealsTab uses GET /api/deals?limit=500, which applies the public website_max_age_hours window (24h). So the Control Room 'All deals' only lists recent or featured deals, not every stored deal. Consider an admin flag to skip the window.
CARD_RE still includes 'emi', but EMI lines are now skipped, so that alternative is unused.
The % check in mark_best_card relies on the label prefix (label.split(' ')[0]). A stored 'unit' or 'pct' field would be more robust.
